svg.text: Project Verona — Juliet (Receiver / Base) Circuit Diagram
ESP32 Dev Module · Ra-02 SX1278 433 MHz LoRa · 16×2 I2C LCD · powered and read over USB
Shows Lat on row 1 and Lon on row 2
micro-USB or USB-C, to match U1
Wire U2 exactly as on Romeo: the eight connections are
U3 LCD: VCC to VIN (5 V), GND to GND, SDA to GPIO21, SCL to
Install the LiquidCrystal I2C library and upload Juliet.ino.
If the LCD is blank, try address 0x3F in the sketch and turn
the blue contrast screw on the backpack.
The LCD backpack pulls I2C up to 5 V. A 0.96 inch SSD1306 OLED
at 3.3 V is a safer alternative.
Fit the 433 MHz antenna to U2 before connecting USB.
Place C1 right next to U2's 3.3V and GND pins. U2 is 3.3 V
Board: ESP32 Dev Module · all logic 3.3 V
